remarks: Welcome to this first-floor end-unit condo in Stamford, offering two bedrooms and one full bathroom. This move-in-ready home features a spacious living room, hardwood floors throughout, and new windows that provide abundant natural light. The functional layout is designed for comfortable living. Additional conveniences include an in-unit laundry, an on-site coin-operated laundry facility, and two parking spaces.  The property is ideally located near major commuting routes, shopping, dining, local parks, and public transportation, offering easy access to everyday amenities. This well-maintained condo is an excellent opportunity whether you are looking for a primary residence or a property to add to a rental portfolio.
